    """
    import numpy as np
    from itertools import combinations

    # Create an ImagePatch object for the image
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)

    # Find all objects in the image
    object_patches = image_patch.find("objects")

    # If there are less than two objects, return 0
    if len(object_patches) < 2:
        return 0

    # Calculate the distance between all pairs of objects
    distances = []
    for pair in combinations(object_patches, 2):
        distances.append(distance(pair[0], pair[1]))

    # Return the average distance
    return np.mean(distances)

        return image_patch

    hat_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2, (p.lower + p.upper) / 2 for p in hat_patches]

    closest_hat_patch = next(p for p in hat_patches if (p.left + p.right) / 2 == closest_hat[0] and (p.lower + p.upper) / 2 == closest_hat[1])
    
    return closest_hat_patch
